query: 碳定价 碳定价 衡量企业将碳成本纳入经营与投资决策的成熟度及透明度。 重点考察： 1）是否对内部碳定价机制进行明确说明（包括肯定或否定声明）； 2）是否探索或建立了碳成本评估机制； 3）碳定价在资本支出或项目评估中的应用深度。 内容质量得分： 2分 (领先)： 正式应用与披露。 企业已建立明确的内部碳定价机制（如影子价格、碳费），披露了具体的定价水平及计算方法，并有实际案例证明该价格已应用于重大投资决策或项目筛选。 1分 (起步/正面回应)： 透明声明与制度探索。 企业在报告中对碳定价议题有正面回应。包括： 明确声明目前尚未建立该机制（透明度体现），即否定声明； 或处于“内部模拟”和“制度探索”阶段； 或仅在原则性描述中提到将碳成本纳入考虑，但尚未形成标准价格。 0分 (缺失)： 完全未披露。 报告中对“碳定价”或“碳成本评估”完全没有提及，未展现出对该议题的任何关注。 内部碳定价 内部碳价 内部影子价格 内部碳费 投资决策碳成本 资本开支碳价筛选 尚未建立内部碳定价 ICP internal carbon price internal carbon pricing shadow carbon price internal carbon fee carbon cost in investment decisions carbon price in capital expenditure no internal carbon price ICP 企业是否披露已建立内部碳定价机制，或明确声明尚未建立？ 是否披露影子价格、碳费或内部碳价水平及计算方法？ 碳价是否用于资本支出、项目筛选或投资评估？ 若尚未正式应用，是否处于内部模拟或制度探索阶段？ 是否有实际应用案例？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '碳定价'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露已建立内部碳定价机制，或明确声明尚未建立？ 是否披露影子价格、碳费或内部碳价水平及计算方法？ 碳价是否用于资本支出、项目筛选或投资评估？ 若尚未正式应用，是否处于内部模拟或制度探索阶段？ 是否有实际应用案例？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅讨论外部碳市场行情而无内部定价；仅有转型风险定性描述；仅有减排目标；仅提及碳税宏观政策而无企业机制；区分：碳定价关注企业内部是否建立并应用碳成本定价机制，含否定声明；转型风险可提及碳价作为外部政策风险，但不等于已建立内部碳定价；场景分析中的碳价假设不等于企业已实施内部碳定价。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Impro Group actively and regularly communicates with internal and external stakeholders to identify and assess ESG materiality development issues as an important basis for the formulation of sustainability strategy. We discuss the materiality issues identified and acknowledge the materiality of the issues. We formulate our sustainability goal, strategy and management direction based on the materiality of the relevant issues, the carbon neutrality and emission peak strategy of the PRC government and the Group's environmentally friendly development philosophy. We pay attention to our peers' and international sustainability performance for active follow-up and regular review on the Group's sustainability-related work.

results.text: We established specialized environmental management teams in various subsidiaries around the world and formulated annual environmental goals incorporating business and production characteristics of the subsidiaries specifically including indicators such as standard pollutant emission rate, comprehensive management rate and completion rates of environmental system training programs. During the Reporting Period, the green capital expenditure used in refurbishing environmentally friendly equipment and enhancing energy conservation amounted to HK$135.1 million with certification from the HKQAA Green and Sustainable Finance Certification Scheme. Impro Group was granted green loan of a total of approximately HK$400 million by DBS Bank and Citibank for purchase of environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production equipment so that the Group can enhance production efficiency while contributing to the creation of a new era of low carbon emission and energy conservation, and give back to society with concrete actions like pursuing green financing. [Content]
We established specialized environmental management teams in various subsidiaries around the world and formulated annual environmental goals incorporating business and production characteristics of the subsidiaries specifically including indicators such as standard pollutant emission rate, comprehensive management rate and completion rates of environmental system training programs. During the Reporting Period, the green capital expenditure used in refurbishing environmentally friendly equipment and enhancing energy conservation amounted to HK$135.1 million with certification from the HKQAA Green and Sustainable Finance Certification Scheme. Impro Group was granted green loan of a total of approximately HK$400 million by DBS Bank and Citibank for purchase of environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production equipment so that the Group can enhance production efficiency while contributing to the creation of a new era of low carbon emission and energy conservation, and give back to society with concrete actions like pursuing green financing. In addition, our environmental protection work has gained external recognition specifically as below :

results.text: We uphold green and low carbon emission as the principle of our operations. We have recorded improvement in various key performance indices of environmental protection in 2021, including a year-on-year decrease of 2.2% in total energy consumption per unit revenue and a year-on-year decrease of 1.9% in greenhouse gas emission per unit revenue. We have established and implemented annual environmental goals and management plans during the year to ensure continuous improvement of the environmental management system. The Group plans to set up long-term realizable targets of greenhouse gas emissions and energy consumption intensity in 2022. Determination and efforts of the Group in energy conservation have been recognized by professional institutions. The Group won the grand award of 'Excellent ESG Enterprise of 2020-2021' by Hong Kong Economic Times in 2021 and was granted green loan of a total of approximately HK$400 million by DBS Bank and Citibank for purchase of environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production equipment.

MESSAGE FROM OUR CHAIRMAN

[Content]
We uphold green and low carbon emission as the principle of our operations. We have recorded improvement in various key performance indices of environmental protection in 2021, including a year-on-year decrease of 2.2% in total energy consumption per unit revenue and a year-on-year decrease of 1.9% in greenhouse gas emission per unit revenue. We have established and implemented annual environmental goals and management plans during the year to ensure continuous improvement of the environmental management system. The Group plans to set up long-term realizable targets of greenhouse gas emissions and energy consumption intensity in 2022. Determination and efforts of the Group in energy conservation have been recognized by professional institutions. The Group won the grand award of 'Excellent ESG Enterprise of 2020-2021' by Hong Kong Economic Times in 2021 and was granted green loan of a total of approximately HK$400 million by DBS Bank and Citibank for purchase of environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production equipment.
